welcomeLead.message: Automatically logs timestamps for your karaoke stream setlists.

welcomeStep1Title.message: First, pin it to the toolbar

welcomeStep1Body.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon (extensions list) at the top right of your browser, then click the 📌 pin icon next to SetPeta. It will stay visible on the toolbar so you can open it instantly.

welcomeStep2Title.message: Click the icon to open the side panel

welcomeStep2Body.message: Clicking the SetPeta icon opens a side panel on the right side of the screen. It stays open even while you interact with the video, so feel free to leave it open during your stream.

welcomeStep3Title.message: Play your karaoke track on YouTube

welcomeStep3Body.message: Playback is detected automatically in any tab, and the "playback time," "video title," and "URL" are logged. You can check and edit the log from the side panel at any time.

welcomeStep4Title.message: Generate the setlist after your stream

welcomeStep4Body.message: Check the archive for the actual start time of the first song, enter it in the side panel, and click "Generate Setlist" to create a timestamped setlist. Use the "Copy" button to paste it straight into your video description.
